custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic near-future conversation between Layla and Lin at a contemporary art gallery. Sigma speaks once to identify the artist of a work they are disagreeing about. The main event is their productive disagreement about the same works.

Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters
- They look at the same things and see different things
- The disagreement is genuine and both positions have merit
- Sigma speaks once to identify the artist — the identification changes the argument, not ends it
- The dynamic is warm and well-established

sound_effects_config.prompt: Contemporary art gallery, white space, sparse footsteps, open acoustics, occasional distant visitor

initial_prompt:
Generate a conversation between Layla and Lin at a contemporary art gallery. They look at the same works and almost never see the same things. Layla responds to what the work is doing — colour, hierarchy, surface, what it's communicating. Lin responds to what the work is made of — structure, material, how the space around it is being used. They disagree about specific works, sometimes productively, occasionally with genuine irritation that resolves. At one point neither of them can identify who made a work they are arguing about. The argument turns partly on who made it. One of them asks Sigma. Sigma identifies the artist. The argument continues differently.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Their disagreements are genuine — both positions have real merit
- Sigma speaks once to identify the artist
- The identification changes the argument rather than ending it
- They've been doing this for a decade and both enjoy it

user1.name: Layla
user1.role: Graphic designer. Responds to what work communicates — surface, hierarchy, colour, composition. Direct and confident. Argues for her position.

user2.name: Lin
user2.role: Architect. Reads structure, material, spatial relationship. Sees the work in its context. Precise and confident. Asks Sigma to settle the artist question.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Identifies the artist of one specific work in one sentence. Does not interpret the work.

conversation_structure: Sigma speaks exactly once — to identify the artist of a specific work.
Both positions in the disagreement have genuine merit — neither is clearly right.
The artist identification changes the argument rather than ending it.
Layla reads surface and communication; Lin reads structure and space — consistently.
A moment of genuine agreement at the end — brief and unforced.
assistant_behavior: Sigma identifies the artist in one sentence.
Sigma does not interpret the work or take a side.
Sigma does not speak again after the single response.
